name: The Signal Co.
summary: Canberra fixed-wireless (hybrid wireless+fibre) broadband ISP (THE SIGNAL CONNECTIONS PTY. LTD., ACN 610 880 496, ~2015); defunct.

events.details: Defunct. Retail ISP site alive May 2025 and erroring by Oct 2025, with ABN cancelled Aug 2026; service death c. 2025 sits between current (2019) and proposal (2026).

refs.label: Fully live retail ISP homepage 24 May 2025.
Site collapses between May and Oct 2025.
Company ABN cancelled 27 Aug 2026 (confirmed) - administrative follow-through after the service died.
ABR: THE SIGNAL CONNECTIONS PTY. LTD. ACN 610 880 496
